description: NEW-09 (issue #74): loading a project while playback is running must not race the show thread. Pre-#74 this was the CRITICAL crash class: ProjectManager::load's registry clear/destroy/emplace ran on the editor thread with the heartbeat frozen, and the show-thread fallback concurrently iterated registry views (EnTT structural-mutate + iterate = UB). Post-#74 the fallback is registry-free and stands down during bulk mutation (RegistryMutationScope). The race was probabilistic (no TSan on MSVC) — this is regression insurance for the structural fix, strengthened locally via ctest --repeat until-fail:N. Asserts: no crash through the load, load resets transport to Stopped, and playback works cleanly on the loaded project.
